💌 From The Heart

To My Dearest Betuu

Sealed with endless love ✨

🌷

My Dearest Betuu,

Aaj tumhara birthday hai aur mere paas shayad shabd kam pad jayein yeh batane ke liye ki tum meri zindagi mein kitni special ho. 🌷

Jab se tum meri life mein aayi ho, har ek din thoda aur khoobsurat aur bright lagne laga hai. Tumhari chhoti-chhoti baatein, tumhari pyaari si smile, aur jis tarah tum har pal ko special bana deti ho—it means the absolute world to me.

Jise tulips pasand hain, uski khud ki personality bhi bilkul ek blooming flower jaisi hai—pure, rare, aur sabke chehre par khushi laane wali. Main hamesha yehi wish karunga ki tumhara har dream poora ho aur hum dono ka yeh bond hamesha aise hi strong rahe.

Happy Birthday once again, my forever favorite person! 🎉💖

Forever Yours 💕
